name: GitLens AI
tagline: GitLens is the most popular VS Code extension for Git, and its AI features include AI-generated commit messages, AI-powered explanations of code changes, and natural language repository search. GitLens Explain lets developers ask questions about any commit, diff, or code block and receive plain-English explanations.
